description: This source file contains unit tests for the HdmiCec_2 plugin using Google Test framework. It tests various methods related to HDMI-CEC functionalities, including device listing, key event sending, and configuration settings. The tests involve mocking dependencies and checking RPC handler responses.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Test
classes.description: Base test fixture class for HdmiCec_2 plugin tests, sets up common components including plugin proxy, handler, connection, and response string.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2DsTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture that mocks additional dependencies related to device communication such as LibCCECImplMock and ConnectionImplMock.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2InitializedTest
classes.description: Extended fixture that initializes a comprehensive mock environment simulating embedded system components, manages the lifecycle of mocks, and tests plugin initialization and shutdown.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2InitializedEventTest
classes.description: Further extension for event-based tests, setting up a types of event dispatchers and mock services.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test method that checks the existence of various RPC registered methods within the handler.

methods.name: getEnabledFalse
methods.description: Test that retrieves the enabled state of CEC before it is explicitly enabled, expecting a false response.

methods.name: getEnabledTrue
methods.description: Test that retrieves the enabled state after setting it to true during plugin initialization, expecting a true response.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatusTrue
methods.description: Test that enables OTP and sets active source, then confirms status is true.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatusFalse
methods.description: Test that retrieves active source status when disabled, expecting false.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Test to retrieve device list after setting OSD name and vendor ID for device at logical address 1, verifies JSON response structure.

methods.name: getOTPEnabled
methods.description: Test that enables OTP and then verifies the OTP enabled status.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Test that sends standby message command and expects success.

methods.name: setOSDName
methods.description: Test setting a new On-Screen Display name and verifying retrieval.

methods.name: setVendorId
methods.description: Test setting a vendor ID and verifying retrieval.

methods.name: setOTPEnabled
methods.description: Test disabling OTP and confirming success.
